memoria.desglose.cargando: We are retrieving the case files behind this figure.
memoria.desglose.vacio: No case files contribute to this figure.
memoria.desglose.actividad: This figure counts team activity. Committee meetings and reports are not linked to case files.
memoria.desglose.foto_antigua: This Annual Report was closed before contributions per case file were stored. The final figure is preserved, but its breakdown is unavailable.
memoria.desglose.no_reproducible: The stored contributions cannot reproduce this figure. Its breakdown is unavailable.
memoria.desglose.cifra_cambiada: The figure has changed since you opened the Annual Report. Go back and retrieve the current figures before opening the breakdown.
memoria.desglose.ayuda: Each case file appears once with its contribution to the selected figure. A case file may contribute several children or adults. Categories come from the Annual Report calculation, without names. Opening a case file shows its current data. For a closed Annual Report, the breakdown preserves the selected revision snapshot.
